subject: an Italian Renaissance artist and engineer with long wavy hair and a long beard, wearing a rose-coloured knee-length tunic and a dark soft cap, a small notebook and red chalk in his left hand, keen observant eyes

panels.01-vinci: the Tuscan hill village of Vinci in 1452, a stone castle tower and church among olive groves and vineyards, rolling hills and cypress trees, soft morning light, wide establishing shot, Renaissance Italy
panels.02-workshop: a busy Florentine Renaissance artist's workshop in the 1460s, a teenage apprentice in a simple tunic grinding pigments and sketching, older artists working on a painted altarpiece and a bronze sculpture, tools and easels, warm light
panels.03-milan: {S} as a man of thirty arriving at the Sforza castle in Milan in 1482, red brick towers and battlements, a lute and rolled drawings of machines under his arm, courtiers in Renaissance dress
panels.04-horse: {S} standing beside a giant clay model of a rearing horse in a Milan workshop around 1494, wooden scaffolding, assistants with tools, the model towering over everyone
panels.05-lastsupper: {S} on a tall wooden scaffold painting a long wall mural of a simple meal scene in a convent dining hall in Milan around 1495, monks watching quietly below, long tables, light from high windows, reverent mood
panels.06-monalisa: {S} at an easel in a quiet Florentine studio in 1503 painting a portrait of a seated woman in a dark gown with folded hands, a misty landscape painted behind her, soft light, brushes and paint pots
panels.07-flight: {S} on a Tuscan hillside around 1505 watching birds soar and sketching wings in a small notebook, a wooden model of a bat-winged flying machine beside him, wind in the grass
panels.08-amboise: an elderly {S} with a long white beard seated at a desk in a stone manor house near Amboise in 1516, notebooks and drawings spread out, a young pupil beside him, a French chateau visible through the window, calm and dignified
